releaseNotes:
What changed:
- Every listing now remembers what it has been searched for, and offers those queries
  back under the box. Films, series, sport, soccer, short dramas, anime and the IPTV
  guide each keep their own list. One press runs a search again; Clear empties that
  one listing's history.
- The player has a Next episode button, named by the episode it goes to, so there is
  no need to sit through the credits to reach it.
- Fixed an episode started from the widget or the television's own Continue watching
  row stopping dead at its own credits instead of rolling into the next one.

Already on 1.53.0 or newer? This installs itself as usual.

On 1.52.1 or older? 1.53.0 changed the app's identity, so Android will not install this
over your copy and the in-app update stops with "The downloaded update belongs to a
different app." Uninstall GIZTV once, then install this build from the release page.
Watch history does not carry across that one reinstall. Updates after it are automatic.
